issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling or edge cases for all function types and deployment scenarios.

scenarios.name: deploy-http-function
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B does not meet any of them.

scenarios.name: deploy-pubsub-function
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes most required flags but uses the wrong secret name, while Response B omits several key flags such as --gen2, correct topic, timeout, and --set-secrets.

scenarios.name: deploy-storage-trigger-function
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes all required flags exactly as specified, while Response A uses different trigger flags and omits --gen2, failing the rubric.
